title: Synthetic Data Generation and Evaluation Dashboard
summary: A Streamlit dashboard that lets users upload tabular data, generate synthetic rows via multiple methods (bootstrap, SMOTE, classification-based), and statistically compare synthetic to original data. SDV's single-table synthesizers (GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, CopulaGAN), its PARSynthesizer, and its evaluation/quality-report functions are directly imported and run as the core generation and validation engine.
